spans.s: गंगा f. 1. The river Ganges, इमं मे गंगे यमुने सरस्वति शतद्रु स्तोमं सचता परुष्या R.V.x.75, R.ii.26 (this name is occasionally applied to several other rivers held sacred in India); 2. the Ganges personified as a goddess.
गांग (I) a. (f. गी) 1. Being in or on the Ganges; 2. coining from or belonging to the Ganges, गांगमंबु सितमंबु यामुनं कज्जलाभम् K.Pr.x., K.S.v.37.
गांग (II) m. 1. An epithet of Bhīṣma; 2. of Kārtikeya.
गांग (III) n. 1. Rain water of a peculiar kind (supposed to be from the heavenly Ganges); 2. gold.
गंगा-अंबु, -अंभस् n. 1. water of the Ganges; 2. pure rain-water such as falls in the month of अश्विन.
गंगा-अंबु, -अंभस् n. 1. water of the Ganges; 2. pure rain-water such as falls in the month of अश्विन.
गंगा-अवतार m. 1. name of a sacred place; 2. the descent of the Ganges on the earth, भगीरथ इव दृष्टगंगावतारः Kad.
गंगा-उद्भेद m. the source of the Ganges.
गंगा-क्षेत्र n. the river Ganges and the district two kośs on either of its banks.
गंगा-चिल्ली f. the Gangetic kite.
गंगा-ज m. 1. a name of Bhīṣma; 2. of Kārtikeya.
गंगा-दत्त m. an epithet of Bhīṣma.
गंगा-द्वार n. the place where the Ganges enters the plains (also called हरिद्वार).
गंगा-धर m. 1. an epithet of Śiva; 2. the occan.
गंगा-धर˚पुर n. name of a town.
गंगा-पुत्र m. 1. an epithet of Bhīṣma; 2. of Kārtikeya; 3. a man of a mixed and vile caste whose business it is to remove dead bodies; 4. A Brāhmaṇa who conducts pilgrims to the Ganges.
गंगा-भृत् m. 1. an epithet of Śiva; 2. the ocean.
गंगा-मध्य n. the bed of the Ganges.
गंगा-यात्रा f. 1. a pilgrimage to the Ganges; 2. carrying a sick person to the river-side to die there.
गंगा-सागर m. the place where the Ganges enters the ocean.
गंगा-सुत m. 1. an epithet of Bhīṣma; 2. of Kartikya.
गंगा-ह्रद m. name of a तीर्थ.
गंगका f. The Ganges.
गंगका f. The Ganges.
गंगका f. The Ganges.
गंगोल m. A precious stone, otherwise called गोमेद.
गंज m. 1. A mine; 2. a treasury; 3. a cow-house; 4. a mart, a place where grain is stored for sale; 5. disrespect, contempt.
गंजा f. 1. A tavern; 2. a drinking vessel; 3. a hut, a hovel.
गंजन a. (f. ना) 1. Contemning, putting to shame, excelling, स्थलकमलगंजनं मम हृदयरंजनम् (चरणद्वयम्) Git.G.x., अलिकुलगंजनमंजनकम् xii.; 2. conquering, कालियविषधरगंजनम् Git.G.i.
गंजन a. (f. ना) 1. Contemning, putting to shame, excelling, स्थलकमलगंजनं मम हृदयरंजनम् (चरणद्वयम्) Git.G.x., अलिकुलगंजनमंजनकम् xii.; 2. conquering, कालियविषधरगंजनम् Git.G.i.
गंजिका f. A tavern, a liquor-shop.
गंड m. 1. The cheek, the whole side of the face including the temple, सपुलकः स्वेदोद्गमे गंडयोः Am.

, तदीयमार्द्रारुणगंडलेखम् K.S.vii.82, Megh.i.26, ii.29; 2. an elephant’s temple; 3. a bubble; 4. a boil, a pimple; 5. goitre and other excrescences of the neck, e.g. गंडस्योपरि पिटकः संवृत्तः Sak.ii.; 6. a joint, a knot; 7. a mark, a spot; 8. a rhinoceros; 9. a warrior; 10. part of a horse’s trappings, a stud or button fixed as an ornament upon the harness.
गंड-अंग m. a rhinoceros.
गंड-उपधान n. pillow, e.g. मृदुगंडोपधानानि शयनानि सुखानि च Suśruta.
गंड-कुसुम n. the juice that exudes from the elephant’s temples, rut, ichor.
गंड-कूप m. a well on the peak or summit of a mountain.
गंड-ग्राम m. any large or considerable village.
गंड-देश, -प्रदेश m. the cheek.
गंड-देश, -प्रदेश m. the cheek.
गंड-फलक n. a broad cheek, धृतमुग्धगंडफलकैर्विषभुर्विकसद्भिरास्यकमलैः प्रमदाः Sis.ix.47.
गंड-भित्ति f. 1. an expansive cheek; 2. the openings in the temples of an elephant from which juice exudes, निर्धौतदानामलगंडभित्तिः (गजः) R.v.43, xii.102.
गंड-माल m. inflammation of the glands of the neck.
गंड-माला f. inflammation of the glands of the neck.
गंड-मूर्ख a. exceedingly foolish, very stupid.
गंड-शिला f. any large rock.
गंड-शैल m. 1. a huge rock thrown down by an earthquake or storm; 2. the forehead.
गंड-साह्वया f. name of a river otherwise called गंडकी.
गंड-स्थल m. 1. the cheek, कस्तूरीवरपत्रभंगनिकरो भ्रष्टो न गंडस्थले Sr.
, गंडस्थलीः प्रोषितपत्रलेखाः R.vi.72, Am.
; 2. the temples of an elephant.
गंड-स्थली f. 1. the cheek, कस्तूरीवरपत्रभंगनिकरो भ्रष्टो न गंडस्थले Sr.
, गंडस्थलीः प्रोषितपत्रलेखाः R.vi.72, Am.
; 2. the temples of an elephant.
गंडक m. 1. A rhinoceros; 2. an impediment, an obstacle; 3. a joint, a knot; 4. a boil, a pimple; 5. disjunction, separation; 6. a coin of the value of four cowries.
गंडका f. A lump, a ball.
गंडक-वती f. the same as गंडकी q.v.
गंडकी f. 1. The name of a river flowing into the Ganges; 2. a female rhinoceros.
गंडकी-पुत्र m. the Sālagrāma stone.
गंडकी-शिला f. the Sālagrāma stone.
गंडली m. An epithet of Śiva.
गंडि m. The trunk of a tree from the root to the beginning of the branches.
गंडिका f. 1. A sort of pebble; 2. a kind of beverage.
गंडीर m. A hero, a champion.
गंडु m.f. 1. A pillow; 2. a knot, a joint.
गंडू f. 1. A joint, a knot; 2. a pillow; 3. oil; 4. bone.
गंडू-पद m. a kind of worm.
गंडू-पद˚भव n. lead.
गंडू-पदी f. a small गंडूपद.
गंडूष m. 1. A mouthful, a handful, गजाय गंडूषजलं करेणुः K.S.iii.37 or गंडूषजलमात्रेण शफरी फर्फरायते; 2. the tip of an elephant’s trunk.
गंडूषा f. 1. A mouthful, a handful, गजाय गंडूषजलं करेणुः K.S.iii.37 or गंडूषजलमात्रेण शफरी फर्फरायते; 2. the tip of an elephant’s trunk.
गंडोल m. 1. Raw sugar; 2. a mouthful.
गंतृ a. (f. त्री) 1. One that goes or moves; 2. one who has sexual intercourse with a woman.
गंतृ a. (f. त्री) 1. One that goes or moves; 2. one who has sexual intercourse with a woman.
गंत्री f. A carriage drawn by oxen.
गांत्री f. A carriage drawn by oxen.
गंत्री-रथ m. the same as गंत्री.
गंध् vt. 10Ā (pres. गंधयते) 1. To injure, to hurt; 2. to ask, to beg; 3. to move, to go.

गंध (I) m. 1. Smell, odour, पुण्यगंधेनांगरागेण R.xii.27, गंधमाघ्राय चोर्व्याः Megh.i.21, when used in this sense as the last member of a Bahuvrīhi comp. with उत्, पूति, सु or सुरभि as the first member, गंध is changed into गंधि. Also when comparison is intended as in उत्पलगंधि मुखं, or when a little of some thing is meant as is घृतगंधि भोजनं); 2. smell considered as one of the 24 guṇas of the Vaiśeṣikas. (It resides in पृथिवी according to them. तत्र गंधवती पृथ्वी T.S.); 3. a perfume, a fragrant substance, e.g. दत्वोदकं गंधमाल्यम् Yaj.i.231; 4. sulphur; 5. pounded sandal-wood; 6. connection, relationship; 7. a neighbour; 8. pride, arrogance; 9. a small quantity.
गंध (II) n. 1. Smell; 2. black aloewood.
गंध-अधिक n. a kind of perfume.
गंध-अपकर्षण n. removing smells.
गंध-अंबु n. fragrant water.
गंध-अम्ला f. the wild lemon-tree.
गंध-अश्मन् m. sulphur.
गंध-अष्टक n. a mixture of eight fragrant substances offered to deities; these substances vary according to the deities to whom they are offered.
गंध-आखु m. the musk-rat.
गंध-आजीव m. a vendor of perfumes.
गंध-आढ्य (I) a. rich in odour, fragrant, e.g. गंधाढ्यासौ भुवनविदिता केतकी स्वरर्णवर्णा.
गंध-आढ्य (II) m. the orange tree.
गंध-आढ्य (III) n. sandalwood.
गंध-इंद्रिय n. the organ of smell.
गंध-इभ, -गज, -द्विप, -हस्तिन् m. the scent-elephant, an elephant of the best kind, गंधद्विपे वन्य इव द्विरेफाः R.vi.7, xvii.70, Kir.xvii.17.
गंध-इभ, -गज, -द्विप, -हस्तिन् m. the scent-elephant, an elephant of the best kind, गंधद्विपे वन्य इव द्विरेफाः R.vi.7, xvii.70, Kir.xvii.17.
गंध-इभ, -गज, -द्विप, -हस्तिन् m. the scent-elephant, an elephant of the best kind, गंधद्विपे वन्य इव द्विरेफाः R.vi.7, xvii.70, Kir.xvii.17.
गंध-इभ, -गज, -द्विप, -हस्तिन् m. the scent-elephant, an elephant of the best kind, गंधद्विपे वन्य इव द्विरेफाः R.vi.7, xvii.70, Kir.xvii.17.
गंध-उत्तमा f. spirituous liquor.
गंध-उद n. scented water.
गंध-उपजीविन् m. one who lives by perfumes, a perfumer.
गंध-ओतु m. (forming गंधोतु or गंधौतु) the civet-cat.
गंध-कारिका f. 1. a female servant whose business it is to prepare perfumes; 2. a female artizan living in the house of another, but not subject to any control.
गंध-कालिका, -काली f. Name of Satyavatī, mother of Vyāsa.
गंध-कालिका, -काली f. Name of Satyavatī, mother of Vyāsa.
गंध-काष्ठ n. aloewood.
गंध-कुटी f. a kind of perfume.
गंध-केलिका, -चेलिका f. musk.
गंध-केलिका, -चेलिका f. musk.
गंध-गुण a. having the property of odour.
गंध-घ्राण a. the smelling of any odour.
गंध-जल n. fragrant water.
गंध-ज्ञा f. the note.
गंध-तूर्य n. a musical instrument of a loud sound used in battle, as a drum or trumpet.
गंध-तैल n. a kind of oil prepared with fragrant substances.
गंध-दारु n. aloewood.
गंध-द्रव्य n. a fragrant substance.
गंध-धूलि f. musk.
गंध-नकुल m. the musk-rat.
गंध-नालिका, -नाली f. the nose.
गंध-नालिका, -नाली f. the nose.
गंध-निलया f. a kind of jasmine.
गंध-प m. an epithet of a class of manes or infernal deities.
गंध-पलाशिका f. turmeric.
गंध-पलाशी f. zedoary.
गंध-पाषाण m. sulphur.
गंध-पिशाचिका f. the smoke of burnt fragrant resin (so called from its dark colour or cloudy nature or from its attracting demons by its fragrance).
गंध-पुष्प (I) m. 1. the vetasa plant; 2. the ketaka plant.
गंध-पुष्प (II) n. a fragrant flower.
गंध-पुष्पा f. the indigo plant.
गंध-पूतना f. a kind of imp or goblin.
गंध-फली f. 1. the priyangu creeper; 2. the bud of the champaka tree.
गंध-बंधु m. the mango tree.
गंध-मातृ f. the earth.
गंध-मादन (I) m. 1. a large black bee; 2. sulphur.
गंध-मादन (II) m.n. name of a particular mountain to the east of Meru.
गंध-मादनी f. spirituous liquor.
गंध-मादिनी f. lac.
गंध-मार्जार m. the civet-cat.
गंध-मुखा ऋ।, -मूषिक म्।, -मूषी ऋ। f. the musk-rat.
गंध-मूषिक m. the musk-rat.
गंध-मुखा ऋ।, -मूषिक म्।, -मूषी ऋ। f. the musk-rat.
गंध-मृग m. 1. the civet-cat; 2. the musk-deer.
गंध-मैथुन m. a bull.
गंध-मोदन m. sulphur.
गंध-मोहिनी f. the bud of the champaka tree.
गंध-युक्ति f. preparation of perfumes.
गंध-राज (I) m. a kind of jasmine.
गंध-राज (II) n. 1. a sort of perfume; 2. sandal wood.
गंध-लता f. the priyangu creeper.
गंध-लोलुपा f. a bee.
गंध-वती f. 1. the earth; 2. wine; 3. Satyavatī, mother of Vyāsa; 4. a kind of jasmine.
गंध-वह m. the wind, दिग्दक्षिणा गंधवहं मुखेन K.S.iii.25.
गंध-वहा f. the nose.
गंध-वाह m. 1. the wind; 2. the muk-deer.
गंध-वाही f. the nose.
गंध-विह्वल m. wheat.
गंध-वृक्ष m. the sāla tree.
गंध-व्याकुल n. a kind of fragrant berry (कक्कोल).
गंध-शुंडिनी f. the musk-rat.
गंध-शेखर m. musk.
गंध-सार m. sandal.
गंध-सोम n. the white water-lily.
गंध-हारिका f. a female servant whose business it is to prepare perfumes.
गंधक m. Sulphur.
गंधन n. 1. Continued effort, perseverance; 2. hurting, killing; 3. manifestation; 4. hint, intimation.

गंधर्व m. 1. A celestial musician, a class of demigods who are considered to be the singers of gods, सोमः शौचं ददावासां गंधर्वश्च शुभां गिरम् Yaj.i.71, M.xii.47; 2. a horse; 3. the musk-deer; 4. the soul after death and previous to its being born again; 5. a singer in general; 6. the black cuckoo.
गांधर्व (I) a. (f. र्वी) Relating or belonging to Gandharvas.

गांधर्व (II) m. 1. A singer, a heavenly chorister; 2. one of the eight forms of marriage. In it, the marital relation proceeds from the mutual inclination of the parties without ceremonies and without the sanction of seniors, (गांधर्वः समयान् मिथः Yaj.i.61) See गंधर्वविवाह; 3. a subordinate Veda treating of music attached to the Sāmaveda. See उपवेद and गंधर्ववेद; 4. a horse.
गांधर्व (III) n. The art of the Gandharvas, i.e. music, यद्गांधर्वकलासु कौशलम् Git.G.iii.
गंधर्व-नगर, -पुर n. the city of Gandharvas, an imaginary city in the sky probably the result of some natural phenomenon.
गंधर्व-नगर, -पुर n. the city of Gandharvas, an imaginary city in the sky probably the result of some natural phenomenon.
गंधर्व-राज m. Citraratha, the chief of the Gandharvas.
गंधर्व-विद्या f. the science of music.

गंधर्व-विवाह m. one of the eight forms of marriage. In it, the marital relation proceeds entirely from the mutual inclination of youth and maiden, without ceremonies and without consulting relatives, M.iii.32. (See under गांधर्व.)
गंधर्व-वेद m. one of the four subordinate Vedas which treat of music (See under उपवेद).
गंधर्व-हस्त, -हस्तक m. the castor-oil plant.
गंधर्व-हस्त, -हस्तक m. the castor-oil plant.
गंधार m. pl. The name of a country and its rulers.

गांधार m. 1. The third of the seven primary notes of music usually denoted by ग; 2. red lead; 3. the name of a country betwen India and Persia, the modern Kānḍahār; 4. a native or a ruler of that country.
गंधाली f. 1. A wasp; 2. continuous fragrance.
गंधाली-गर्भ m. small cardamoms.
गंधालु a. Fragrant, perfumed.
गंधिक (I) a. (f. का) (used only at the end of compounds) 1. Having the smell of, e.g. उत्पलगंधिका; 2. having a very little of, e.g. भ्रातृगंधिका ‘a brother only by name.’
गंधिक (II) m. 1. A seller of perfumes; 2. sulphur.
गंधिक (I) a. (f. का) (used only at the end of compounds) 1. Having the smell of, e.g. उत्पलगंधिका; 2. having a very little of, e.g. भ्रातृगंधिका ‘a brother only by name.’
गांधिक (I) m. 1. A vendor of perfumes, a perfumer; 2. a scribe, a clerk.
गांधिक (II) n. Fragrant wares, perfumes, पण्यानां गांधिकं पण्यं किमुच्चैः कांचनादिकैः Panch.i.
गंभारिका f. Name of a tree.
गंभारिका f. Name of a tree.
गंभीर (I) a. (f. रा) See गभीर, R.i.36, Megh.ii.1, 3.
गंभीर (II) m. 1. A lotus; 2. a citron.
गंभीर (I) a. (f. रा) See गभीर, R.i.36, Megh.ii.1, 3.
गंभीरा f. The name of a river, गंभिरायाः पयसि Megh.i.40.
गंभीर-वेदिन् a. restive (as an elephant).
गंभीरा f. The name of a river, गंभिरायाः पयसि Megh.i.40.
गांग (I) a. (f. गी) 1. Being in or on the Ganges; 2. coining from or belonging to the Ganges, गांगमंबु सितमंबु यामुनं कज्जलाभम् K.Pr.x., K.S.v.37.
गांगट m. A kind of prawn or shrimp.
गांगट m. A kind of prawn or shrimp.
गांगायनि m. 1. An epithet of Bhīṣma; 2. of Kārtikeya.
गांगेय (I) a. (f. यी) Being in or on the Ganges.
गांगेय (II) m. See गांगायनि.
गांगेय (III) n. Gold.
गांगेय (I) a. (f. यी) Being in or on the Ganges.
गांजिकाय m. A quail.
गांडिव m.n. 1. The bow of Arjuna, presented by Soma to Varuṇa, by Varuṇa to Agni and by Agni to Arjuna, गांडीवं स्रंसते हस्तात् Bg.i.29; 2. a bow in general.
गांडिव m.n. 1. The bow of Arjuna, presented by Soma to Varuṇa, by Varuṇa to Agni and by Agni to Arjuna, गांडीवं स्रंसते हस्तात् Bg.i.29; 2. a bow in general.
गांडिव-धन्वन् m. an epithet of Arjuna, Megh.i.48.
गांडिव-धन्वन् m. an epithet of Arjuna, Megh.i.48.
गांडीविन् m. An epithet of Arjuna, the third Pāṇḍava prince.
गान n. Singing, a song.
गांदिनी f. 1. An epithet of the Ganges; 2. name of a princess, the mother of Akrūra.
गांदिनी-सुत m. an epithet (1) of Bhīṣma; (2) of Kārtikeya; (3) of Akrūra.
गांधर्व (I) a. (f. र्वी) Relating or belonging to Gandharvas.
गांधर्व-चित्त a. one whose mind is possessed by a Gandharva.
गांधर्व-शाला f. a muic hall, a concert room.
गांधर्वक m. A Singer.
गांधर्वक m. A Singer.
गांधारि m. An epithet of Śakuni, Duryodhana’s maternal uncle.
गांधारेय m. An epithet of Duryodhana.
गांभीर्य n. 1. Deepness, depth (of water, sound &c.); 2. depth or profundity (of a meaning, a character, a subject &c.), Sis.i.55, R.iii.32.
